node_definition.done_when: Done when tests/test_a_tick_walks_the_process_table_once.py , on a temporary crew home, runs live_work_populations over 40 terminal pointers whose liveness read must take the walk: each pointer records a pid that is dead on this host and a run record showing a worker existed, the condition under which local_liveness enters _env_scan_run_pid . A recording stand-in replaces process_signal._walk_marked_processes , and a beat clock advances past BEAT_SECONDS between pointers. The test asserts one walk, and that the returned populations equal those at the base revision. Negative control: at the base revision the count is 40. The test files importing the changed modules add no failure against base in matched arms run as an all_debug partition job, submitted with env -u SLURM_JOB_ID -u SLURM_JOBID sbatch and never on the fleet node. Each arm's log sits under the run directory, opens with its revision and literal command, and ends in EXIT= . ruff check and ruff format --check add no finding on the staged paths.
